page.overview:
Who is Abominable Snowkoopa?

The Abominable Snowkoopa is a monstrous snowman created by Big Mouth Koopa in the The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3 episode "7 Continents for 7 Koopas." It was created by him to take over Antarctica and terrorize the penguins living there.

It essentially has the appearance of a regular snowman, complete with a top hat and a scarf, which has a pattern consisting of blue and green squares.

Abominable Snowkoopa's name is a pun on the "abominable snowman," but with "Koopa" replacing the suffix "-man."
